tagline: An internally managed REIT acquiring and managing single-tenant properties net-leased to service-oriented and experience-based businesses.
hero_kpi_rationale: The real estate portfolio is the primary driver of growth and recurring revenue generation, with a strategy focused on long-term net leases in resilient, service-oriented sectors.

kpis.name: Portfolio Size (number of properties)
kpis.explanation: Total number of properties owned by the company, including undeveloped land and those securing mortgage loans.
kpis.description: The portfolio increased from 1,947 properties at end-2024 to 2,300 at end-2025, supported by new acquisitions.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth of the real estate portfolio

kpis.name: Annualized Base Rent
kpis.explanation: Contractual annual rental income generated by in-place leases.
kpis.description: 91.5% of rent comes from service and experience-oriented sectors, which are resilient to e-commerce.

kpis.name: Rental Revenue
kpis.explanation: Income generated from rental payments collected during the year.
kpis.description: The 23.9% increase is primarily due to new property acquisitions in 2024 and 2025.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by portfolio expansion

kpis.name: Weighted Average Lease Term
kpis.explanation: Average remaining lease term, weighted by annual rent.
kpis.description: A long lease term (14.4 years) ensures cash flow predictability and reduces re-leasing risk.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.description: The portfolio is nearly fully occupied, reinforcing revenue stability.
kpis.signal: Very low risk of lease vacancy

kpis.name: Net Real Estate Investment
kpis.explanation: Total value of net real estate investments after depreciation.
kpis.description: Increased from $5.2 billion at end-2024 to $6.2 billion at end-2025, reflecting strong acquisition activity.
kpis.signal: Significant expansion of the real estate balance sheet

kpis.name: Interest Expense
kpis.description: Increase driven by higher debt levels and interest rates in 2025.

kpis.name: Gain on Dispositions
kpis.explanation: Profit realized from the sale of real estate properties.
kpis.description: The company sold 60 properties in 2025 versus 46 in 2024, generating higher net gains.

kpis.name: Portfolio Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in the number of properties owned by the company.
kpis.description: Growth from 1,947 to 2,300 properties between 2024 and 2025.

kpis.name: Net Real Estate Investment Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in the value of net real estate investments.
kpis.description: Increased from $5.2 billion to $6.2 billion over one year, reflecting an active expansion strategy.

risks.title: Tenant Dependency and Risk Concentration
risks.summary: A significant portion of rental income comes from tenants operating in service and experience sectors, exposing the company to risks if these sectors are negatively affected.
risks.score_rationale: The document states that 91.5% of rental income comes from tenants in service and experience sectors. While diversification is a goal, high concentration in certain tenant types increases risk if these sectors are impacted. The language is factual, but concentration is inherently a risk.

risks.title: Sale-Leaseback Investment Risk
risks.summary: Heavy reliance on sale-leaseback transactions may expose the company to risks if market conditions become less favorable for such deals.
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily uses sale-leaseback transactions. While presented as a strategy, this creates dependency on companies' ability to sell their real estate assets and lease them back, which can be sensitive to market conditions.

risks.title: REIT Distribution Requirements
risks.summary: Regulatory requirements for REITs mandate distributing most earnings, limiting the company's ability to self-fund growth and making it dependent on external capital sources.
risks.score_rationale: As a REIT, the company must distribute 90% of its taxable income, limiting retained earnings for growth. The text notes this may require alternative financing (asset sales, debt, equity), whose availability and terms are not guaranteed.

risks.title: Dependence on Access to Capital Markets
risks.summary: The company's growth depends on its ability to access capital markets. Unfavorable market conditions or other factors could hinder access and compromise the growth strategy.
risks.score_rationale: Growth strategy relies heavily on continuous access to capital markets (debt and equity). The text lists numerous factors that could affect access (market conditions, leverage, credit rating, etc.), indicating an existential risk if access is blocked.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: Rising interest rates directly increase borrowing costs and reduce the net profitability of real estate investments.
risks.score_rationale: Debt interest expense rises with interest rates. The report shows a 37.6% increase in interest expense in 2025, directly tied to higher rates and increased leverage. This reduces profitability and limits financial flexibility.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention any strategy, technology, or investment related to artificial intelligence in its financial filings.
evidence: No mention of AI in Business, MD&A, or Risk sections.
No reference to automated analytics tools, AI-driven optimization, or operational digitization.
Activities are centered on traditional net-lease real estate management.
